-- EP-488 v51 / G9: Degree-3 coexistence ratio (5.4-β)
-- Claim: If a < b are both degree-3 vertices in B_n under the constraints
-- a ∈ (q/2, 3q/5) and b ∈ (q/2, 3q/5), then 5b < 6a.
--
-- Proof: a > q/2 gives q < 2a. b < 3q/5 gives 5b < 3q. Combined: 5b < 3q < 6a.
-- Wait, 5b < 3q and q < 2a gives 5b < 3q < 6a, i.e. 5b < 6a. Direct.

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- If q/2 < a, 5b < 3q (from b < 3q/5), and a < b, then 5b < 6a. -/
theorem deg3_coexist_ratio
    {q a b : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : q / 2 < a)
    (hb : 5 * b < 3 * q)
    (hab : a < b) :
    5 * b < 6 * a := by
  sorry
